input.question: What is another common name for the Hummingbird Bush?

documents.text: Justicia californica Justicia californica is a species of flowering shrub native to the deserts of southern California, Arizona, and northern Mexico. Its common names include chuparosa (or chiparosa, both colloquial Spanish terms for "hummingbird"), hummingbird bush, and beloperone. It is one of the northernmost distributed species of the mostly tropical genus "Justicia". This is a low bush which grows in dry, hot regions in the sand or rocky terrain of the desert floor.
